t: British Foreign Office Advisory for British tourists in Malta following the collapse of Thomas Cook
html:
The British Foreign Office has issued the following advisory for British citizens in Malta following the announcement that Thomas Cook has ceased trading.

If you’re travelling and have been affected by the announcement that Thomas Cook has ceased trading, you should visit thomascook.caa.co.uk for the latest updates. Those overseas can call the CAA helpline on +44(0)1753 330 330 and for those in the UK the Freephone number is 0300 303 2800.

Via The Foreign Office
